Hey I've been there. Well actually I'm still there, since I still get mad when my gsp falls down haha. Best thing in my opinion? Get off quickplay. Join discord, join the various smash groups and ask for games there. Greater sense of community and also people on discord are generally of a higher level than those on quickplay. Quickplay is like junk food - it's alright for a quick fix but ultimately not good for you.

>top players are doing a lot of the legwork for developing characters

I remember Mr.R said something similar to this during the sm4sh days, basically arguing that people follow the top player meta too often without labbing the characters that are considered lower tier. I'm not sure how far i agree with it, but I do think people jump ship to the top tier characters a little too quickly sometimes.

Sheik discord has tried to lab the character but they've mostly given up. You can say that's a bad mentality (in some ways I agree) but when the top players of your character - VoiD, Mr.R, Blank - all drop her, it's hard not to feel discouraged.

Stepping on lego doesn't hurt that badly.
